description: Source code for the NXP TJA1103 Ethernet PHY driver in Zephyr RTOS, including register definitions, initialization, link management, IRQ handling, and configuration functions.

methods.name: phy_tja1103_c22_read
methods.description: Reads a 16-bit register via MDIO Clause 22.

methods.name: phy_tja1103_c22_write
methods.description: Writes a 16-bit register via MDIO Clause 22.

methods.name: phy_tja1103_c45_read
methods.description: Reads a register via MDIO Clause 45.

methods.name: phy_tja1103_c45_write
methods.description: Writes a register via MDIO Clause 45.

methods.name: phy_tja1103_reg_read
methods.description: Reads a PHY register, enabling/disabling MDIO bus as needed.

methods.name: phy_tja1103_reg_write
methods.description: Writes a PHY register, enabling/disabling MDIO bus as needed.

methods.name: phy_tja1103_id
methods.description: Retrieves the PHY ID to verify device identity.

methods.name: update_link_state
methods.description: Checks and updates the link status of the PHY.

methods.name: phy_tja1103_get_link_state
methods.description: Gets current link state, optionally updating via interrupt or polling.

methods.name: invoke_link_cb
methods.description: Invokes the registered callback on link state change.

methods.name: monitor_work_handler
methods.description: Periodic work to monitor link status and invoke callback if changed.

methods.name: phy_tja1103_irq_offload_thread
methods.description: Dedicated thread to handle IRQ offload processing.

methods.name: phy_tja1103_handle_irq
methods.description: IRQ handler that signals the offload thread.

methods.name: phy_tja1103_cfg_irq_poll
methods.description: Configures GPIO interrupt or fallback to polling mode.

methods.name: phy_tja1103_init
methods.description: Initializes the PHY device, verifies ID, configures registers, sets up IRQ or polling.

methods.name: phy_tja1103_link_cb_set
methods.description: Sets callback for link status changes.
